children: Alpha Wave Global, the US-based alternative asset manager majority-owned by Abu Dhabi's financial services holding company Judan Financial, has joined a consortium of institutional investors committing nearly $1 billion in fresh equity to Adani Airport Holdings Limited (AAHL), in a deal that values India's largest private airport operator at about $18 billion before the investment.

AAHL said it has entered into binding agreements to raise 98.25 billion Indian rupees ($1 billion) in primary equity capital from a group of investors that includes Alpha Wave Global, Premji Invest, Temasek and funds managed by BlackRock.
Upon completion of the three investment tranches, the investor consortium will collectively own about 5.54% of AAHL.

Judan Financial was launched by Abu Dhabi-based International Holding Company (IHC) in February as an AI-powered financial services platform expected to oversee approximately AED 870 billion ($237 billion) in assets under management.

In March, Judan Financial acquired a 50.1% stake in Alpha Wave Global. The alternative asset manager's portfolio includes investments in SpaceX, its largest holding, as well as Anthropic, OpenAI and Cerebras, among other technology companies.
(Writing by Brinda Darasha; editing by Seban Scaria)

title: Abu Dhabi’s Judan-backed Alpha Wave joins $1bln consortium investing in Adani Airport
